{"consolidated_memory":"## Route Shadowing in api/gateway/router.go - Two Occasions

**Occasion 1: Cold Start Triggering [2026-02-11]**
- File: api/gateway/router.go (api gateway side)
- Problem: route shadowing in the router
- Signal: wrong handler name in the request span
- Trigger: only on first request after cold start
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #1965, branch fix/route-shadowing-1)
- Repro: curl the two overlapping prefixes in order
- Test coverage: api/gateway/router_test.go
- Outcome: flaky test went from 78 failures per hundred runs to zero

**Occasion 2: OAuth Provider Sessions [2026-04-25]**
- File: api/gateway/router.go (same api gateway side, same corner of code)
- Problem: route shadowing in the router
- Signal: wrong handler name in the request span
- Trigger: only for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #9604, branch fix/route-shadowing-3)
- Repro: curl the two overlapping prefixes in order
- Outcome: backlog cleared 57 minutes after deploy
- Note: context from earlier route shadowing work (Occasion 1) carried over to this fix

Both occasions involved the same surface-level problem (route shadowing) and same trigger mechanism (overlapping route prefixes), but manifested under different conditions with different root causes and required different fixes targeting time/deadline handling in different ways."}
